# DANI DECLARES LLC — Vendor Referral Partner Agreement

**DRAFT / ATTORNEY REVIEW REQUIRED BEFORE THIS GOVERNS A REAL SIGNATURE**

This is a **separate agreement from** `DANI_PROVIDER_AGREEMENT_DRAFT.md`, and the two must not
be used interchangeably. The Provider Agreement assumes DANI DECLARES sets the customer price
and pays the provider a payout (the cleaning/dispatch model). This agreement is for the
opposite commercial relationship: the vendor sets and collects their own price directly from
the customer, and DANI DECLARES is paid a referral fee for the introduction. Signing a vendor
under the wrong agreement misstates who is paying whom and for what.

## 1. Relationship

This agreement does not create employment, partnership, joint venture, or agency. Vendor is an
independent business. DANI DECLARES ("DANI") refers customer inquiries to Vendor; DANI does not
control Vendor's pricing, scope, quality, methods, or scheduling for the referred work.

## 2. Scope of Referral

DANI may introduce customer inquiries to Vendor for the specific service category(ies) Vendor
has been approved for in the DANI provider portal. A referral is not a guarantee of any volume
of leads or bookings, and DANI may refer the same customer inquiry to more than one vendor.

## 3. Pricing and Payment

**Vendor sets Vendor's own price and bills the customer directly.** DANI DECLARES does not
process payment for Vendor's services and is not a party to the payment transaction between
Vendor and the customer.

## 4. Referral Fee

Vendor will pay DANI DECLARES a referral fee of **[FEE PERCENTAGE — proposed default 15%,
confirm before use]** of the total price Vendor charges the customer for each booking that
resulted from a DANI DECLARES referral. Vendor is responsible for reporting closed bookings
and remitting the referral fee within **[PAYMENT TERMS — e.g. 7 days of completed service,
confirm before use]**. DANI DECLARES currently tracks and invoices referral fees manually;
this is not yet an automated billing process.

## 5. Vendor Responsibility for Service Quality

Vendor is solely responsible for the quality, safety, legality, licensing, insurance, and
timely delivery of Vendor's own services. DANI DECLARES makes no warranty regarding Vendor's
work and is not liable for Vendor's acts, omissions, or failure to perform. Vendor will
maintain any license, permit, certification, or insurance required for the services Vendor is
approved to provide, consistent with the equipment/credential requirements confirmed during
Vendor's provider-portal application.

## 6. Compliance and Licensing

Vendor represents that Vendor holds and will maintain any license, permit, certification, or
insurance legally required for Vendor's services, and will promptly notify DANI if any such
requirement lapses. DANI may suspend or remove Vendor's referral eligibility if compliance
documentation expires or becomes insufficient.

## 7. Confidentiality

Vendor will keep confidential any customer, property, financial, or operational information
received through a DANI DECLARES referral, and will use it only to perform the referred work
and collect the referral fee owed under Section 4.

## 8. No Circumvention

For any customer introduced through a DANI DECLARES referral, Vendor will not knowingly
structure future bookings with that same customer to avoid the referral fee owed under Section
4 for work that reasonably originated from the referral relationship. [Scope/duration of this
clause is a business and legal judgment call — confirm before use; an overly broad
non-circumvention clause can itself be unenforceable or invite disputes.]

## 9. Termination

Either party may end this relationship at any time by written notice. Termination does not
affect referral fees already owed for bookings that closed before the termination date, or
Vendor's confidentiality obligations under Section 7.

## 10. No Warranty / Limitation

DANI makes no warranty regarding the volume, timing, or profitability of any referral offered
under this agreement.

## 11. Governing Law

Governing law and venue are to be specified after attorney review based on DANI's actual state
of formation and primary operating jurisdiction.

## 12. Entire Agreement

This document is the entire agreement between the parties regarding referral-based vendor
services unless a separately signed writing says otherwise.
